title: HIL Test Engineer
summary: HIL (hardware-in-the-loop) test engineers test car control units on a bench that simulates the rest of the vehicle, so software can be checked before it goes into a real car. They write and automate test cases, keep the benches running and sit in the validation team of a vehicle maker or supplier.
dailyDuties: Write test specifications from ECU requirements
Automate test cases in Python or C++ on the HIL bench
Set up restbus simulation and plant models
Run regression tests on each new software release
Analyse failures with network traces and measurement data
Log defects for the software team

skills.expectation: Run and maintain HIL benches such as dSPACE SCALEXIO or NI VeriStand
Automate HIL test cases and build the test framework
Automate HIL test cases and build the test framework
Use CANoe and CAPL for restbus simulation and UDS checks
Work with CAN, LIN and other in-vehicle buses on the bench
Use and adjust Simulink plant models for closed-loop tests
Write test specifications from ECU requirements
Execute and report regression tests for each ECU software release
Run HIL tests nightly from a CI pipeline such as Jenkins
Measure ECU signals with CANape or INCA during tests
Cover safety requirements in HIL tests
Test ADAS features with sensor simulation
Log defects with traces for the software team
Keep test scripts and framework code in version control

groups.label: A test framework language (Python or C++)
